about: Professor Hoot's lines for Inside a Leaf (docs/design/games/leaf-voyage.md section 3.8): each spoken by itself (PlayVoice.say), at most 12 words; a question names what answers it: 'world' (what happens next) or the pictures a HUD shows.

lines.text: Oh no! Our sunflower is drooping in the heat.
Good! But it still droops. Let's look inside!
Touch the leaf. Size Magic!
Smaller... smaller... we're tinier than a hair!
Up through a door! Let's go in.
Look! The water is escaping through the doors.
Squeeze the doors shut. Your turn!
Yes! The water stays in now.
Squeeze the two green sides together.
The cells are full. The sunflower is standing up!
Open doors let water out. Closed doors keep it in.
The green workshops have stopped. They need air.

lines.when: a door opened in a blaze
lines.text: Too hot! The water rushes out.
Wait for the sun to hide.
A cloud! It's cooler now. Open the doors!
Air plus light makes sugar. The plant makes its own food!
Scientists call these doors stomata.
Sun's back! Close the doors!
Carry the sugar to the gold pipe.
That pipe brings water in. Sugar goes in the gold one.
The bud is full! Let's grow back and see!
Look! It's standing tall... and it's opening!
The plant got heavier. The soil didn't.
Every petal was built from air you let in!
Real sunflowers work their doors all by themselves. Now you know how!
Wonderful work! Another voyage?
The leaf is too dry! Close the doors.
A cactus from the desert! It's hot and thirsty.
Let's look inside its green stem. Size Magic!
Phew, it's baking! Keep the doors shut.
No clouds in the desert. When does it cool down?
The sun is setting. Feel that cool air?
The cactus keeps the air in jars for tomorrow!
Doors shut, and it still builds. Clever cactus!
A flower that opens at night. The desert's secret!
Desert plants open their doors at night, when it's cool.
You helped a desert plant, like a real botanist!
You waited for the cloud. Clever!
Closed before the heat. Like a real plant!
Your sugar is on its way!
Great timing!
The leaf is happy and full.
You're getting really good at this!
Hoo hoo! Well done!
Need a rest? The triangle goes on, the door stops.
Leave the voyage? The sunflower will wait for you.
Just a ladybird. Hello up there!
I'm a tiny owl! Don't sneeze!
It's like a green cathedral!
